insights.headline: Deep Emotional Capacity
insights.summary: You experience the world with profound emotional intensity and deep empathy.
insights.details: A deep, unblemished heart line shows that when you commit, you do so entirely. You form strong, enduring attachments and often serve as an emotional anchor for the people in your life. While you may feel things more acutely than others, this sensitivity is your greatest asset in forming genuine connections.
insights.advice: Protect your emotional reserves. Because you give so much, you must be intentional about surrounding yourself with people who reciprocate.
